title: Tagged machine family
statement:
Let $d$ be a natural number, let $S_j$ be a state set for each $j
e d$ with $0\le j<d$, and let each $M_j$ be a deterministic machine with $K$ Boolean work tapes and state set $S_j$. Define a machine with $K$ work tapes whose states are either a distinguished initial state or a pair consisting of an index $j$ and a state in $S_j$. The initial state is distinguished; from it the machine halts, while from a tagged state it performs the corresponding machine's transition and tags any successor state with the same index.
